value.rationale: The result turns a uniform quadratic finite-model blow-up into a graph-sensitive m*chi(G) bound while proving that the quadratic regime is genuinely necessary for complete two-agent S5 conflict. This directly affects the size of proper relational representatives used before translation to simplicial models and identifies the exact obstruction graph driving duplication.
